ELECTRICITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1999
An Ordinance further to amend the Electricity Act, 1910
[Gazette of Pakistan Extraordinary, Part II, 24th May, 1999].

for general information.
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Electricity (Amendment) Ordinance, 1999.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Addition of new section 50-A, Act IX of 1910

ORDINANCE VI OF 1999
ORDINANCE VI OF 1999
ELECTRICITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1999
An Ordinance further to amend the Electricity Act, 1910
[Gazette of Pakistan Extraordinary, Part II, 24th May, 1999].
No.F.2(1)/99-Pub., dated
24-5-1999.--The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published
for general information.
5. Addition of new section 50-A, Act IX of 1910.--In the said Act,
after section 50, the following new section shall be inserted, namely:--
"50-A.
Cognizance of offences, etc.--(1) No Court inferior to that of a Magistrate of
the First Class shall try an offence punishable under this Act.
(2) Notwithstanding anything
contained in section 32 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 (Act V of
1898), it shall be lawful for any Magistrate of the First Class to pass any
sentence authorised by this Act."
